entities.name: Vera Blagojević
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vera Blagojević was a Yugoslav medical student and Communist political activist. During World War II, she was captured by the Gestapo in 1942 and later killed. She was posthumously awarded the Order of the People's Hero in 1953.
